answer.summary: Frontend build fails deterministically with a JSX syntax error in Graph.tsx: a <Box> opened at line 239 is closed by </Stack> at line 290, then a stray token at line 292. The PR touches Graph.tsx, so the change most likely introduced this. Re-running will fail the same way; fix the unbalanced JSX tags.
